title: CapexOne Plus: overview film
description: Capital projects, checked live. A narrated tour of the CapexOne Plus demo with fictional data, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 72 seconds: CapexOne Plus checks capital projects against their business case. It shows the planner, gate pack, project value, invoice approval and the CFO portfolio view, and an API built for agents. The shared-savings model sets a 3 % saving goal: one third is our fee, two thirds stay with the client, a target, not a guarantee. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Last month’s slides and forty hours per gate review.
CapexOne Plus checks every capital project against its business case, live.
Describe the investment; a rule engine builds the stage-gate plan.
Before every review, the gate pack builds itself.
NPV and IRR, against the approved case.
Every invoice passes the approval matrix before it reaches the ERP.
The CFO sees value at risk across the portfolio.
We aim to save you three percent: a third is our fee, two thirds stay with you. A goal, not a guarantee.
Guillermo Rauch: focus on the API. So we did: 173 documented endpoints.
CapexOne Plus. Decide on live numbers.
